title: 第2章 主角登场
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 将这里的情况清晰告知后，许牧挂掉电话，等待馆主陈丧过来。夜色深沉。许牧倚着墙，于灯光昏黄的走廊安静思考。看见女尸坐起来的那一幕，换作上辈子的自已，估计早飞起来了。刚才竟然只用了几秒钟就镇静下来，而且还和女尸演起了对角戏。是因为穿越，对这种灵异事件有了心理预期？还是因为盼望激活金手指，潜意识里一直期待类似的事情发生？但是我刚才的处理还有点过于莽了，万一那孕尸的执念是杀人，那后果不堪设想，以后得注意这点……许牧自我审视地点头。大约三十多分钟后，在殡仪馆外透气的许牧，终于看见一辆有些年头的小汽车驶进院子。车门打开，从里面下来一位中年男子，身形精瘦，颧骨略高，四十来岁，正是殡仪馆老板陈丧。陈丧目光先扫过了整栋建筑，最后才定格在许牧身上。“小许，带我过去看看。”他平静说道，脸上不见半点慌乱。挺镇定的嘛，难道这种事情不是第一次发生？怪不得这个殡仪馆会给值班人员配备管制刀具作为安保装备。应该是以前也出过事，所以在警方那里得到了许可……许牧一下联想到很多。再次穿过灯光昏黄的走廊，两人来到停尸房外，推开门，那股混合着血腥和腐烂的恶臭扑面而来。陈丧眉头挤了一下，径直走向那具女尸。他站在床边，俯身仔细查看女尸被剖开的腹部，又看了看她怀中抱着的那滩烂肉。“这真是你做的？”他回过头，盯着许牧，目光如炬，确定般地询问道。虽然提前电话沟通过，事实也摆在眼前，但陈丧还是忍不住重新审视起许牧。这个自称青藤大学历史系的大三学生，似乎并不像表面那样简单。你这是什么眼神，不会是要我赔偿吧……许牧暗暗腹诽，点头说道：“没错，这种情况，算不算故意毁坏尸体？”听见许牧的回答，陈丧笑了：“年轻人，你很诚实，也很幽默。”不，我是真的很严肃地在问，诚实则是因为有监控摄像头……许牧心中默默反驳。陈丧从兜里摸出一包烟，递给许牧一支，许牧摆手拒绝，他也不在意，自已点上，深深吸了一口。他自顾自地说道：“我在青藤市开殡仪馆11年，类似的事情发生过7次。”他吐出一口烟，目光悠远，“每次的值班人员都是吓得屁滚尿流，你是第一个独自把问题解决掉的人，许牧，你很厉害。”正常来说，屁滚尿流才符合逻辑……许牧并没有骄傲自大，他略微颔首，试探问道：“那接下来，是不是该报警处理？我是指专门处理类似事件的那种。”“你很敏锐。”陈丧呵呵笑道，扔掉烟头，又续上一支。这不难推敲，既然这个世界存在超凡因素，甚至会体现在现实生活中。而普通百姓并不知情，就说明消息被封锁得相当严密，背后肯定有对应的势力在做。这个势力，大概率就是处于国家层面的官方组织。“只是正常的猜测。”许牧微笑应道，没有在意对方的夸赞。陈丧一口吸完小半截烟，神情愉悦地回答刚才的问题：“你猜得没错，正常来说确实要‘报警’。但现在不用，因为他们就在这里。”就在这里？许牧下意识环顾周围，这里除了面前的陈丧，就只剩那些尸体了。难道陈丧就是官方组织的人？可他为什么又要说‘他们’？疑惑之际，许牧悚然发现了异常！他看见面前的地上，自已的影子竟然开始扭曲蠕动起来！他明明没有任何动作，就算有动作，也不会投射出那样诡异的影子。旋即，他看见自已的影子在扭曲蠕动中分裂为二。它们像活着的石油般汇聚堆叠，倒流往上，快速凝实。最后褪去黑色，染上色彩，呈现出了两个活生生的人。我艹！你们好歹也是官方人员，出场方式就不能正常点？许牧差点就张大了嘴巴，他在内心爆了句粗口，双脚不自觉后退两步。虽然刚刚才经历了尸体生孩子的场面，但他还是被眼前的这一幕惊讶到了。旋即，他豁然明悟，他们这显然是在作暗中的观察，也是对意外的预防。如果发现我被污染，成为下一个怪物，他们将会毫不犹豫地击杀我，以非常高效、直接、出其不意的方式。还真是可怕啊，我的危险预感一点动静也没有，跟假的一样……呃，不能质疑自已的能力，或许是因为他们从始至终都没有做出攻击的动作。换个角度看，他们主动暴露自身，就说明已经确认我没有问题。许牧念头急转，想通了这种出场方式的背后逻辑。以诡异方式登场的两名官方人员，站在许牧和陈丧之间，面向许牧。两人一男一女，年龄都在二十五岁左右。男人剑眉星目，极为英俊，他戴着金边眼镜，身穿白色衬衫，黑色裤子和皮鞋，整个人玉树临风，潇洒自若。女人五官精致，短发齐肩，同样穿着白衬衫，黑裤子，黑皮鞋，衬衫下摆束进裤腰，将纤细腰肢完美展现了出来，整体凹凸有致，站在那里亭亭玉立。般配！这是许牧在看清二人后第一个闪现出脑海的词。此时，有同样想法的不只许牧自已。他突然看见了一行接一行、一列又一列、色彩不一的虚幻文字从眼前掠过。【不愧是男女主，太般配了，高举星瑾大旗！！】【陆剑星！风华瑾！陆剑星！风华瑾！陆剑星！风华瑾】【他俩也太坏了，这出场方式，看给对面吓得一愣一愣的】【虽然但是，对面那个好像也不错哦……很戳我】【这建模确实有点东西，前面的姐妹，我认可你】…………虚幻文字接连不断，许牧先是一怔，随即就反应过来，明白发生了什么。真是踏破铁鞋无觅处啊，对面这俩不就是系统说的核心人物吗？自已只有出现在他们身边，才能进入外界观众的视野。只是没想到我居然能看见外界观众发的弹幕……许牧收敛表情，调整姿态，假装随意地看向停尸房里的其余三人，发现他们并没有异常表现。看来只有我能看见这些弹幕。他暗自点头，确认想道。戴金边眼镜的陆剑星上前一步，露出一个挑不出一点瑕疵的笑容，既大方又礼貌地表达了歉意：“抱歉，我们这样出现有些冒昧。”以后抱歉的事别干……许牧摆摆手，嘴角扯出一个礼貌性的微笑：“不用在意。”陆剑星话锋一转，赞赏道：“不过对于刚独自一人解决了一件超凡事件的你来说，我想问题不大。”陆剑星说话的同时，他身旁的风华瑾也在好奇地打量对面的许牧。许牧嗯了一声：“确实，心理上有预期。”陆剑星点点头，自我介绍道：“我们隶属于超凡事务管理调查局，数字代号749局，我叫陆剑星。”接着他半转身体，“这是我的同事兼搭档，风华瑾。”“许牧。”许牧平静回应。【这许牧是什么角色？主角团的人还是配角】【不知道，制作组爆料时没提过】【路人吧，用过就丢的那种】【怎么可能是路人，他能处理超凡事件，我觉得像反派】
content_en: After clearly informing him of the situation here, Xu Mu hung up the phone and waited for the owner of the hall, Chen Sang, to come over.The night is dark.Xu Mu leaned against the wall and thought quietly in the dimly lit corridor.When he saw the female corpse sitting up, he would have been flying long ago if he had been in his previous life.It only took a few seconds to calm down, and he even acted opposite the female corpse.Is it because of time travel that I have psychological expectations for such supernatural events?Or is it because you are looking forward to activating the golden finger, and you have been subconsciously expecting something similar to happen?But my handling just now was a bit too reckless. If the pregnant corpse's obsession is to kill people, the consequences will be disastrous. We must pay attention to this in the future... Xu Mu nodded with self-examination.About thirty minutes later, Xu Mu, who was taking a breather outside the funeral home, finally saw an old car driving into the yard.The car door opened, and a middle-aged man got out. He was lean and had slightly high cheekbones. He was in his forties. He was Chen Sang, the owner of the funeral home.Chen Sang's eyes first scanned the entire building, and finally settled on Xu Mu."Xiao Xu, take me over and take a look." He said calmly, without any trace of panic on his face.You're quite calm. Isn't this the first time this kind of thing has happened?No wonder this funeral home equips the staff on duty with controlled knives as security equipment.It must have happened before, so he got permission from the police... Xu Mu thought of many things at once.Passing through the dimly lit corridor again, the two came to the outside of the morgue. When they opened the door, the stench of blood and decay hit their faces.Chen Sang frowned and walked straight towards the female corpse.He stood by the bed, leaned over and carefully looked at the dissected abdomen of the female corpse, and then looked at the puddle of rotten flesh in her arms."Did you really do this?" He turned around, stared at Xu Mu, and asked with certainty.Although they had communicated on the phone in advance and the facts were before their eyes, Chen Sang couldn't help but re-examine Xu Mu.This self-proclaimed junior from the History Department of Ivy League University seems to be not as simple as he appears.What kind of look are you looking at? You're not asking me to compensate... Xu Mu secretly slandered, nodded and said, "Yes, in this case, does it count as intentional destruction of the body?" Hearing Xu Mu's answer, Chen Sang smiled: "Young man, you are very honest and humorous." No, I was really asking seriously, and honesty was because of the surveillance cameras... Xu Mu retorted silently in his heart.Chen Sang took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and handed one to Xu Mu. Xu Mu waved his hand to refuse, but he didn't care. He lit it himself and took a deep breath.He said to himself: "I have been running a funeral parlor in Qingteng City for 11 years, and similar things have happened seven times." He blew out a puff of smoke and looked far away, "Every time, the staff on duty were scared to death. You are the first person to solve the problem alone. Xu Mu, you are very powerful." Normal.It is only logical to make a mess...Xu Mu was not arrogant. He nodded slightly and asked tentatively: "Then, should we call the police? I mean the kind that specializes in handling similar incidents." "You are very sharp." Chen Sang chuckled, threw away the cigarette butt, and added another one.This is not difficult to reason about. Since there are extraordinary factors in this world, they will even be reflected in real life.The fact that ordinary people don't know about it means that the information is blocked very tightly, and there must be corresponding forces behind it.This force is most likely an official organization at the national level."It's just a normal guess." Xu Mu replied with a smile, not paying attention to the other person's compliment.Chen Sang finished smoking half of the cigarette in one gulp and answered the question with a cheerful expression: "You are right. Normally, you do have to 'call the police'. But you don't need to now, because they are here." Right here?Xu Mu subconsciously looked around. Apart from Chen Sang in front of him, there were only corpses left here.Could it be that Chen Sang was from the official organization?But why did he say 'them' again?When he was confused, Xu Mu suddenly discovered something unusual!He saw that on the ground in front of him, his own shadow began to twist and squirm!He obviously didn't move at all, and even if he did, he wouldn't cast such a weird shadow.Immediately, he saw his own shadow split into two as it twisted and squirmed.They gather and stack like living oil, flowing upward and solidifying quickly.Finally, the black faded away and dyed with color, revealing two living people.Fuck!You are also official personnel after all, so why don’t you act more normally?Xu Mu almost opened his mouth. He cursed in his heart and took two steps back unconsciously.Although he had just experienced the scene of a corpse giving birth to a child, he was still surprised by the scene in front of him.Immediately, he suddenly realized that they were obviously making secret observations and preventing accidents.If they find that I am contaminated and become the next monster, they will kill me without hesitation, in a very efficient, direct and unexpected way.It's really scary. My premonition of danger didn't move at all, just like a fake... Well, I can't question my ability, maybe because they didn't make any attack movements from beginning to end.Looking at it from another angle, by taking the initiative to expose themselves, it means they have confirmed that there is nothing wrong with me.Xu Mu's thoughts changed quickly and he figured out the logic behind this way of appearing.Two official personnel who appeared in a strange way stood between Xu Mu and Chen Sang, facing Xu Mu.They were a man and a woman, both around twenty-five years old.The man has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and is extremely handsome. He wears gold-rimmed glasses, a white shirt, black pants and leather shoes.The woman has delicate features, short hair reaching her shoulders, and is also wearing a white shirt, black pants, and black leather shoes. The hem of the shirt is tucked into the waistband of the pants, which perfectly shows off the slender waist. The whole body is uneven, and she stands tall and graceful.A perfect match!This was the first word that came to Xu Mu's mind after seeing the two of them clearly.At this time, Xu Mu himself was not the only one who had the same idea.He suddenly saw line after line, column after column, illusory words of different colors passing before his eyes.[As expected of the male and female protagonists, they are a perfect match. Hold high the banner of Xingjin!!】【Lu Jianxing!Fenghuajin!Lu Jianxing!Fenghuajin!Lu Jianxing!Feng Huajin] [They are both too bad. The way they appear makes the other side stunned for a moment] [Although, the one on the other side seems pretty good...it really pokes me] [There is indeed something about this modeling, sisters in front of me, I agree with you]... The illusory words continued one after another. Xu Mu was startled at first, but then he realized what was going on.It's really hard to find anything after trying to break through the iron shoes. Aren't the two people on the opposite side the core figures of the system?Only by appearing next to them can you enter the field of vision of the outside audience.I just didn't expect that I could actually see the barrage posted by the outside audience... Xu Mu calmed down his expression, adjusted his posture, pretended to look at the other three people in the morgue casually, and found that they did not behave abnormally.It seems that only I can see these barrages.He nodded secretly, confirming his thoughts.Lu Jianxing, who was wearing gold-rimmed glasses, took a step forward, showed a flawless smile, and expressed his apology generously and politely: "Sorry, it was a bit presumptuous for us to show up like this." Don't do anything you're sorry for in the future... Xu Mu waved his hand and made a polite gesture at the corner of his mouth.With a smile: "Don't worry." Lu Jianxing changed the topic and praised: "But for you who just solved an extraordinary incident alone, I don't think it's a big problem." While Lu Jianxing spoke, Feng Huajin beside him was also curiously looking at Xu Mu opposite him.Xu Mu hummed: "Indeed, I have psychological expectations." Lu Jianxing nodded and introduced himself: "We are affiliated with the Paranormal Affairs Management and Investigation Bureau, with the digital code name Bureau 749. My name is Lu Jianxing." Then he half-turned around and said, "This is my colleague and partner, Feng Huajin." "Xu Mu." Xu Mu responded calmly.[What kind of role is this Xu Mu?Are the people in the protagonist group or supporting roles?] [I don’t know, the production team didn’t mention it when they broke the news] [Just passers-by, the kind that you throw away after use] [How could he be a passer-by, he can handle extraordinary events, I think he looks like a villain]
